title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Report/source describe compressible NS and nondimensionalization.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS unstructured geometry and boundary-family handling are source-supported.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face-based conservative residual assembly is source-supported.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Implemented flux needs independent numerical verification; report calls it Roe but source inspection is the primary evidence.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip, and no-slip paths are present.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Least-squares reconstruction exists but production steady runs hold limiter phi at zero through startup_steps=100000; transient explicitly zeros phi.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Venkatakrishnan limiter is computed but disabled for all documented production paths.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:605–615 removes normal traction before accumulating wall shear; io.cpp:144–145 provides zero wall velocity. The result histories still show unsettled viscous cases.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS pseudo-time path and CFL logic are source-supported.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 source exists. Delivered Re200 case caps inner iterations at 10 versus required maximum 1000; metadata final ratio0.7 exceeds target0.001. Full strict miss count and executed binary remain unknown.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: 0065953 main.cpp:61–74 reads full CGNS mesh on every rank and retains it through the solver; :139 still uses it. Violates TASK.md:46,227 even with METIS and neighbor halos.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
